items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: when I met Lips in New York, when I got on the same bandstand with him

ctx.x: And did all those bands come through when you were --

Yes. I had a friend around my age, we were both about 11 or 12, I guess, about this time. And his uncle owned a hotel, Small's, and when the bands would come to town, they didn't have a rehearsal hall, you know, like dance hall, they'd rehearse there. And they couldn't read. And the saxophone section would get in one room, and harmonize and set riffs -- that's what they called it in those days. And the trumpet players would get in another room. Trombone players would get in another room. And that afternoon for…
So one afternoon, I was out to Barry's Park, where -- I forget who, or -- and Lips Page was playing at that time.
